title: Consolidation specialist/especialista de consolidação - oportunidade também para pcd
description:
Nova vaga disponível para Consolidation specialist/especialista de consolidação - oportunidade também para pcd em campinas. Saiba mais sobre essa oportunidade.

PURPOSE OF THE POSITION:   The Consolidation Specialist contributes to the production of Imerys' quarterly consolidated financial statements in accordance with IFRS standards, by overseeing the financial statements of the Americas subsidiaries with the Americas Consolidation Manager, and producing Group analyses in coordination with the Group Consolidation team (totalling 9 people), spread across Paris, Brussels, Singapore, and Campinas, covering overall a scope of approximately 220 entities spread across some fifty countries.   The Consolidation Specialist also collaborates closely with the administration team of the SAP FC consolidation software, as well as other departments within Finance (Reporting, Tax, Treasury), both in Brazil and abroad.   KEY TASKS AND RESPONSIBILITIES:   Quarterly package review   - Supervise the correct and timely completion of quarterly reporting packages in SAP FC for the Americas scope.   - Analyze balance sheets and variances, equity analyses, tax reviews, and reconciliation of intercompany transactions.   - Ensure the resolution of blocking control and support reporting units with technical queries throughout the closing process.   - Ensure that the consolidated accounts of entities in the region comply with IFRS standards and Group policies.   - Establish, manage, and communicate reporting schedules and closing deadlines for the region.   Group analyses   - Contribute to global Group topics, including IFRS 16 (Leases) reviews, mining accounting issues, and other specific key performance indicators.   One-off items   - Assist units in preparing for quarterly closings by anticipating the IFRS treatment of specific transactions according to the Group accounting manual.   - Support Mergers & Acquisitions (M& A), divestitures, or internal mergers within the Americas scope.   - Define solutions to improve processes, reporting timelines, and the reliability of consolidated data.   OTHER IMPORTANT FUNCTIONS:   The position includes regular discussions with external auditors regarding the Americas scope and assistance with internal audit requirements. Previous experience in auditing is highly desirable.   REQUIREMENTS:   Education: Bachelor's degree in Accounting (Certified Accountant).   Experience: Minimum of 5 to 7 years in accounting, with a strong focus on consolidation and external auditing.   Languages: Fluent English (mandatory for writing and speaking) and advanced Spanish (desirable).   Know-how, skills, abilities and other characteristics:   Technical Skills: Proficiency in Google and Microsoft applications (especially Excel); experience with financial software and databases such as SAP BFC (reporting tool - desirable), SAP 4 HANA (desirable) and Anaplan (desirable).   Soft Skills: Team player, ability to build trust-based relationships with peers and international contacts, and focus on continuous improvement.   Essential Qualities: Organized, strict adherence to deadlines, analytical mindset, autonomy, transparency, and a proactive attitude toward learning.   In commitment to Diversity, Equity and Inclusion, this opportunity is also aimed at candidates with disabilities.

title: Customer service de agenciamento internacional
description:
Nova vaga disponível para Customer service de agenciamento internacional em campinas. Saiba mais sobre essa oportunidade.

VAGA PARA SUPERESTRELA DE CUSTOMER SERVICE AGENCIAMENTO INTERNACIONAL  Você é apaixonado(a) por Comércio Exterior, gosta de desafios, sabe trabalhar com múltiplos embarques ao mesmo tempo e acredita que Customer Service vai muito além de responder e-mails? Então esta oportunidade pode ser para você.    IMPORTANTE    Esta vaga é exclusiva para profissionais residentes em Campinas/SP e região. Se você não reside na área ou não pode atuar presencialmente, por favor, não se candidate. Recebemos muitas candidaturas e analisaremos apenas aqueles que atenderem aos requisitos e enviarem o áudio solicitado.      SE VOCÊ   ✔ Possui experiência comprovada em Customer Service de Agenciamento Internacional de Cargas ;   ✔ Já coordenou operações de Importação e/ou Exportação;   ✔ Possui inglês intermediário ou avançado;   ✔ Tem facilidade para se comunicar com clientes, armadores, agentes de carga, companhias aéreas, transportadoras e fornecedores internacionais;   ✔ Domina documentos de comércio exterior como BL, AWB, Invoice, Packing List, entre outros;   ✔ É organizado(a), proativo(a), comunicativo(a) e sabe administrar diversos processos simultaneamente;   ✔ Resolve problemas com rapidez, mantém o cliente informado e trabalha bem sob pressão;   ✔ Valoriza o trabalho em equipe e possui senso de prioridade.    O DESAFIO    Você será responsável pela coordenação completa dos embarques internacionais, realizando a interface entre clientes, agentes de carga, armadores, companhias aéreas, transportadoras e demais fornecedores envolvidos na operação.      Suas principais responsabilidades incluem:     Coordenação de embarques de Importação e Exportação; Acompanhamento operacional dos processos de ponta a ponta; Contato diário com agentes internacionais; Interface entre clientes, fornecedores e equipes internas; Conferência de documentação; Controle de prazos; Acompanhamento de bookings; Atualização constante dos clientes sobre o andamento das operações; Tratativa e solução de ocorrências operacionais; Garantir uma experiência de excelência aos clientes.    Não procuramos apenas alguém para seguir processos, mas sim uma pessoa que assuma responsabilidades, resolva problemas, antecipe situações e seja uma referência para nossos clientes.     ---      COMO SE CANDIDATAR    Envie seu currículo juntamente com um Á UDIO de até 2 minutos para        ROTEIRO DO Á UDIO   1. Quem é você em 20 segundos?    Informe seu nome, cidade, experiência atual e área de atuação.   2. Quais resultados concretos você já entregou em Customer Service?    Conte uma situação real em que tenha coordenado operações complexas, solucionado problemas importantes, reduzido atrasos, melhorado processos ou aumentado a satisfação dos clientes.   3. Qual sua experiência real em Comércio Exterior?    Fale sobre os modais com que já trabalhou (marítimo, aéreo e rodoviário), tipos de embarques (FCL, LCL etc.), documentos que domina e situações desafiadoras que já enfrentou.    Evite respostas genéricas.   4. Como você lida com metas, pressão e múltiplos embarques simultaneamente?    Conte uma situação real e explique como organizou prioridades e entregou resultados.   5. title: Reiseberater:in brasilien (freelance, vor ort)
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Reiseberater:in brasilien (freelance, vor ort) em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

Travel Buddies Wir sind ein Team, das in den Destinationen lebt, die wir verkaufen. Unsere Buddies in Kuba, Vietnam und Namibia planen jede Reise selbst und betreuen die Gäste vor Ort. Das ist der Grund, warum Leute bei uns buchen.Wir arbeiten direkt mit lokalen Partnern, ohne Zwischenhändler. DRSF-zertifiziert, Trustpilot 4,9/5, bekannt aus WELT und Handelsblatt. Jetzt bauen wir Brasilien auf. Du wärst die erste Person dafür.Was du machst Du lebst in Brasilien und kennst das Land aus deinem Alltag, deinen Freundschaften, deiner Arbeit. Du hast zwei Aufgaben bei uns:Du sprichst mit deutschsprachigen Reisenden, die bei uns einen Beratungstermin gebucht haben. Du verstehst, was sie wollen, und planst mit uns gemeinsam ihre Reise — Routen, Unterkünfte, Erlebnisse. Du bist die Stimme aus Brasilien, wir bauen das Angebot daraus.Wenn deine Gäste in Brasilien ankommen, bist du ihr Ansprechpartner. Per Whats App, im Call, manchmal persönlich. Du löst Probleme, wenn der Inlandsflug nach Salvador gestrichen wird oder die Pousada überbucht ist. Du organisierst Begegnungen, die im Reiseführer nicht stehen — die Köchin für deine Moqueca, den Jangadeiro mit seinem Segelfloß im Nordosten, den Musiker in der Roda de Samba, den Capoeira-Lehrer, den du persönlich kennst.Du arbeitest 1:1 mit deinen Gästen. Dein Job ist, sie über dein Netzwerk und deine Geschichte mit dem Land zu verbinden.Was du mitbringen musst Du lebst seit mehreren Jahren in Brasilien. Mit Alltag, Freundeskreis, festen Strukturen. Deutsch auf Muttersprache- oder C1-Niveau. Die Beratung läuft auf Deutsch. Du hast eine eigene Geschichte mit dem Land. Warum bist du gekommen, was hält dich. Du arbeitest selbstständig und bist gut erreichbar — per Whats App und im Video-Call.Was zusätzlich hilft Portugiesisch-Kenntnisse Englisch fließend Erfahrung in Tourismus, Hospitality oder Beratung Ein eigenes Netzwerk an Hotels, Pousadas, Drivern, Köchen Vertrautheit mit CRM, Google Workspace, Whats App Business Zugang zu Menschen, die einen Gast persönlich beeindrucken: Köche, Musiker, Fischer, Capoeira-Lehrer, Flussbootskapitäne im AmazonasWas wir bieten Freelance-Vertrag mit flexiblen Stunden. Als Nebentätigkeit gedacht für jemanden, der ohnehin im Land lebt. Vergütung auf Stundenbasis plus Boni für Buchungen und gute Bewertungen. Du baust eine Destination von null auf und prägst, wie wir Brasilien machen. Ein eingespieltes Team im Rücken: Buchungen, Verträge, Tools, Versicherung. Du machst das, was nur du kannst. Langfristige Zusammenarbeit über Jahre.

title: FinCrime Analyst - Brazil
description:
Empresa está contratando FinCrime Analyst - Brazil em campinas. Veja detalhes e envie seu currículo.

About Revolut  People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 75+ million customers get more from their money every day. As we continue our lightning-fast growth, 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 13,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution. About the role  Our Financial Crime team blends regulatory expertise with data-driven thinking to make sure our products meet legal and policy requirements and deliver real value to customers. In a fast-moving, digital environment, they stay one step ahead by finding smart, scalable ways to prevent financial crime. We're looking for a FinCrime Analyst to review and get to the bottom of customer issues. You’ll collaborate with colleagues, both internally and externally, to solve cases and deliver an outstanding customer experience. To support our 24/7 coverage, this role may include night and weekend shifts, which are fully compensated. Up to shape what's next in finance? Let's get in touch. What you'll be doing  Conducting due diligence reviews of customers, businesses, and transactions using internal systems, screening tools, and external sources Reviewing and investigating alerts generated by sanctions, PEP, KYC/KYB, and transaction monitoring systems to identify potential risks Performing financial crime risk assessments to detect suspicious activity, including money laundering, terrorist financing, fraud, and other predicate offences Escalating potential compliance, sanctions, or financial crime issues to relevant escalation teams, MLROs, or Compliance leadership Validating customer and corporate documentation to ensure customer due diligence (CDD) and onboarding requirements meet internal policies and regulatory standards Conducting risk-based reviews of individuals and entities (e.g., directors, shareholders, UBOs) to identify regulatory, fraud, and compliance risks Analysing customer profiles, nature of business, and transactional activity to identify inconsistencies, red flags, or deviations from expected behaviour Collaborating with internal stakeholders, including Support, Compliance, and Product teams to resolve complex cases and improve procedures  What you'll need  A bachelor's degree or equivalent Fluency in English and Portuguese (C1+ level) 2+ years of FinCrime experience Familiarity with investigative methodologies evidenced by use of analytical tools (e.g., spreadsheets, filters, pivots, network charts) A willingness to work a variety of shifts, including nights and weekends Critical thinking skills Impeccable attention to detail The ability to multitask, prioritise, and work well under pressure  Nice to have  A degree in law or STEM subject A professional certification (ICA or ACAMS) Fluency in other languages  Building a global financial super app isn’t enough. Our Revoluters are a priority, and that’s why in 2021 we launched our inaugural D&I Framework, designed to help us thrive and grow everyday. We're not just doing this because it's the right thing to do. We’re doing it because we know that seeking out diverse talent and creating an inclusive workplace is the way to create exceptional, innovative products and services for our customers. That’s why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard-working team. Important notice for candidates:  Job scams are on the rise. Please keep these guidelines in mind when applying for any open roles. • Only apply through official Revolut channels.  We don’t use any third-party services or platforms for our recruitment. • Always double-check the emails you receive.  Make sure all communications are being done through official Revolut emails, with an @revolut.com domain. We won't ask for payment or personal financial information during the hiring process.  If anyone does ask you for this, it’s a scam. Report it immediately. By submitting this application, I confirm that all the information given by me in this application for employment and any additional documents attached hereto are true to the best of my knowledge and that I have not wilfully suppressed any material fact. I confirm I have disclosed if applicable any previous employment with Revolut. I accept that if any of the information given by me in this application is in any way false or incorrect, my application may be rejected, any offer of employment may be withdrawn or my employment with Revolut may be terminated summarily or I may be dismissed. By submitting this application, I agree that my personal data will be processed in accordance with Revolut's Candidate Privacy Notice

Bora movimentar o esporte!!

title: Customer Support Specialist - Brazil
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Customer Support Specialist - Brazil em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

Job Description: Customer Support Specialist Who We Are:   Shoplift, an American software startup based in NYC, helps thousands of e-commerce merchants like Kith, Liquid Death, Olukai, and more, acquire online customers efficiently and profitably by optimizing their online storefronts with our intelligent, automated experimentation and personalization platform.  Your Role:  As a Customer Support Representative at Shoplift, you'll be the daily face of Shoplift to thousands of merchants. You'll own the resolution of merchant issues across chat, email, and calls, diagnosing problems accurately, responding with empathy and clarity, and seeing every case through to a confident close. You're the first person a merchant turns to when something isn't working, and the quality of that moment shapes how they feel about the entire platform. You'll do more than close tickets. You'll build real product and platform expertise, recognize the patterns behind recurring issues, and feed what you learn back to Product, Engineering, and Customer Success so the whole experience gets better. When you spot a merchant at risk or an opening to grow, you'll route that signal to the right account owner fast. Why this role matters:   Storefront optimization is no longer a \"nice-to-have\"; it's becoming table stakes for ecommerce success. Merchants are trusting Shoplift with decisions that directly move their revenue, and every support interaction either reinforces or erodes that trust. Support isn't a cost center here. It's a direct input to retention, satisfaction, and growth, and you're on the front line of it. Responsibilities:  Support delivery:  Own the resolution of merchant issues across chat, email, and calls. Diagnose accurately, respond with empathy and clarity, and see each case through to a confident close. Escalate complex, high-impact, or time-sensitive issues to the Support Team Lead promptly and with clear, complete context so nothing stalls in handoff.  Service quality and consistency:  Ensure every response reflects Shoplift's standards for accuracy, tone, and helpfulness. Use support macros correctly and flag any that are outdated or misaligned with current product behavior so they can be corrected quickly. Deliver the consistency merchants expect regardless of who picks up their ticket.  Product and platform expertise:  Maintain deep, current knowledge of how A/B testing, experiment setup, and CRO workflows function for merchants day to day, and understand enough of the underlying Shopify environment to reason about issues in context. Product fluency is what separates a good answer from a resolution that actually moves the merchant forward.  Cross-functional collaboration:  Partner with Product and Engineering by reproducing issues cleanly, documenting them clearly, and surfacing recurring patterns that point to deeper fixes. Meet support SLA targets across priority levels and keep tickets moving on the \"waiting on us\" side of any dependency.  Retention and expansion signal:  Recognize retention risk and expansion opportunity in the course of support conversations, and route those signals quickly and accurately to the relevant CSM or account owner. Reinforce merchant trust and satisfaction in every interaction.  Continuous improvement:  Strengthen self-serve and AI-enabled support by identifying gaps in documentation, macros, and help content, and recommend improvements to tools, training, and enablement based on what you see in the queue. Support the ramp of new teammates by sharing knowledge and modeling the service standard  What We’re Looking For:  Must-haves:  Shopify ecosystem experience. You've worked in or around the Shopify platform and understand how merchants operate within it, including apps, themes, and the merchant admin. You can speak a merchant's language from day one. Direct-to-consumer fluency. You understand the DTC and ecommerce world, how online brands think about conversion and growth, and the pressures merchants face. This context lets you prioritize correctly and respond with credibility. Proven front-line support experience delivering high-quality service across chat, email, and phone. Strong verbal and written proficiency with English, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly and empathetically to non-technical merchants. Strong diagnostic instincts and a bias toward full resolution over deflection. Comfort working at pace in a high-growth environment where processes are still being built.  Nice-to-haves:  Familiarity with A/B testing, experimentation, or conversion rate optimization (CRO). Prior experience supporting a SaaS or B2B software product. Experience with support tooling such as ticketing systems, macros, and AI-assisted support workflows. Light technical exposure (HTML/CSS, JavaScript) or familiarity with analytics platforms (Google Analytics, GA4, Segment).

Nós corrigimos as falhas das tecnologias comuns, aplicando uma Inteligência Artificial lapidada e integrada de forma nativa. O comerciante elimina custos com múltiplos softwares, reduz despesas fixas e gerencia o negócio inteiro com um único login. Risco Zero de Desenvolvimento O maior medo de um investidor em tecnologia é o atraso ou o fracasso no desenvolvimento do software. Na Yummi, esse risco não existe. O produto mínimo viável está cem por cento concluído e funcional. A infraestrutura está pronta e testada para suportar alta demanda de acessos. Nosso foco atual é zero por cento em programação e cem por cento em marketing e vendas. Assist with client correspondence and preparation of legal deliverables. Support process improvements and standardization of legal templates and document workflows.  Requirements  Education & Licensure:  Law Degree (LL.B., J.D., or regional equivalent) from an accredited law school. U.S. Context:  Deep experience supporting U.S.-based companies, cross-border transactions, or working under common law principles. Negotiation Skills:  Strong commercial acumen with a proven ability to redline contracts effectively and negotiate directly with opposing counsel.  Technical Requirements  Document Management:  Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Word (specifically tracking changes and document comparison), Excel, and Google Workspace. Innovation:  Experience leveraging AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, specialized legal AI) to drive legal operations efficiency and streamline workflows.

The ideal candidate is highly connected within the local market, with a strong network of liquidity providers and a deep understanding of regional payment and banking landscapes. Key Responsibilities  Business Development & Partnerships  Identify, source, and establish relationships with local and regional liquidity providers Evaluate LP quality (pricing, depth, reliability, regions covered) Negotiate trading terms (spreads, fees, credit lines, margin terms)  Market & Network Development  Leverage existing network to expand LP coverage in key regions (APAC, LATAM, Africa) Maintain strong relationships with banks, payment providers, and liquidity partners Stay up to date with local market dynamics, pricing trends, and competitive landscape  Execution & Collaboration  Work closely with traders to ensure optimal liquidity, pricing, and execution quality Coordinate with internal teams to onboard LPs and ensure smooth operational setup Support ongoing performance monitoring and optimization of LP relationships  Banking & Infrastructure Setup  Facilitate opening of bank accounts and payment rails required for LP operations Identify suitable partners to support local currency flows and settlement  Requirements  5 to 10 years of experience in business development, partnerships, or liquidity management Strong experience in payments, FX, trading, or related financial services Well connected with liquidity providers, banks, and payment partners Proven ability to source and onboard LPs in local markets Strong understanding of regional market structures and liquidity dynamics Must have strong, deep LP network in at least one of the following regions: LATAM   Vision & Mission  OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors. OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

Strong experience leading accounting, treasury, financial reporting, and regulatory compliance functions. Desired Competencies  Regulatory reporting expertise, including COSIF, SCE-IED, Unicad (IN BCB 712/713), and BACEN compliance   Nice to Have  Experience in fintech, payments, digital assets, stablecoins, or blockchain technology. Hold any professional registrations or licenses required under Brazilian law to perform the responsibilities of the position, where applicable. Head of Risk (Crypto) (Brazil-based)  About the Company:  We are one of the world's earliest and most established digital asset platforms, serving tens of millions of users across global markets. Consistently ranked among the top exchanges worldwide, we support a comprehensive suite of trading and wealth management products across thousands of digital assets. With thousands of employees spanning key financial hubs globally, we operate with a remote-first, high-autonomy culture that attracts talent who thrive in fast-moving, intellectually demanding environments. We are building the financial infrastructure of the next era of the internet — and we're looking for exceptional finance professionals to help shape it. The Role:  We are in search of a business-oriented Head of Risk (Crypto) to lead the overall risk management function for our Brazil entity. This role focuses on end-to-end risk management across trading, financial crime, and product risk, while ensuring the company operates within its defined risk appetite while actively supporting business growth. Unlike traditional compliance-heavy roles, this position is about risk ownership: identifying exposures, calibrating tolerance, and driving real-time control execution. We're looking for someone who understands that well-designed risk frameworks are a business enabler, not a brake. We welcome candidates with a strong crypto or digital asset background. We are equally open to risk leaders from traditional financial institutions, capital markets, fintech, or payments companies who bring deep, transferable expertise and a genuine appetite to operate in a more dynamic, high-growth environment. What You'll Do:  Establish and lead the company's enterprise-wide risk management framework, covering trading and market risk, product risk, financial crime risk, and operational risk. Define, review, and continuously optimise the risk appetite framework in alignment with overall business strategy. Monitor risk activities to ensure alignment with internal risk policies, business objectives, and applicable Brazilian regulatory expectations, and other relevant regulatory authorities. Partner with senior leadership and the Board to embed risk-informed thinking into strategic decision-making. Build and enhance risk control mechanisms across transaction monitoring and risk indicators, market surveillance controls, and product risk assessment frameworks. Identify and stay ahead of emerging risks in trading, product design, and operations, and lead mitigation strategies. Strengthen internal control systems and drive effective risk governance across the organisation. Support the company's ongoing regulatory engagement and risk governance as Brazil's digital asset regulatory framework continues to evolve.  What We're Looking For:  10+ years of risk management experience within crypto, financial institutions, capital markets, fintech, payments, or digital asset businesses. Deep expertise in enterprise risk management, including risk appetite frameworks, governance, and internal controls. Strong understanding of trading, transaction, and financial crime risks, with the ability to balance effective risk management against commercial objectives. Ability to translate risk frameworks into practical controls and work cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Compliance, and Operations to implement them. Proven track record operating at or reporting to Executive Committee and Board level. Strategic thinker with the confidence to influence senior stakeholders and embed a strong risk culture across the organisation spanning across operational, market and liquidity risk. Expert understanding of Brazilian regulatory expectations relating to financial institutions and digital asset service providers. Crypto or digital asset experience is strongly preferred, but we also welcome candidates from traditional financial services with strong transferable risk expertise and a genuine interest in the digital asset sector. Functional knowledge of digital asset or digital token listing processes is preferred.

title: Reiseberater:in Brasilien (Freelance, vor Ort)
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Reiseberater:in Brasilien (Freelance, vor Ort) em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

Travel Buddies  Wir sind ein Team, das in den Destinationen lebt, die wir verkaufen. Unsere Buddies in Kuba, Vietnam und Namibia planen jede Reise selbst und betreuen die Gäste vor Ort. Das ist der Grund, warum Leute bei uns buchen. Wir arbeiten direkt mit lokalen Partnern, ohne Zwischenhändler. DRSF-zertifiziert, Trustpilot 4,9/5, bekannt aus WELT und Handelsblatt. Jetzt bauen wir Brasilien auf. Du wärst die erste Person dafür. Was du machst  Du lebst in Brasilien und kennst das Land aus deinem Alltag, deinen Freundschaften, deiner Arbeit. Du hast zwei Aufgaben bei uns: Du sprichst mit deutschsprachigen Reisenden, die bei uns einen Beratungstermin gebucht haben. Du verstehst, was sie wollen, und planst mit uns gemeinsam ihre Reise — Routen, Unterkünfte, Erlebnisse. Du bist die Stimme aus Brasilien, wir bauen das Angebot daraus. Wenn deine Gäste in Brasilien ankommen, bist du ihr Ansprechpartner. Per WhatsApp, im Call, manchmal persönlich. Du löst Probleme, wenn der Inlandsflug nach Salvador gestrichen wird oder die Pousada überbucht ist. Du organisierst Begegnungen, die im Reiseführer nicht stehen — die Köchin für deine Moqueca, den Jangadeiro mit seinem Segelfloß im Nordosten, den Musiker in der Roda de Samba, den Capoeira-Lehrer, den du persönlich kennst. Du arbeitest 1:1 mit deinen Gästen. Dein Job ist, sie über dein Netzwerk und deine Geschichte mit dem Land zu verbinden. Was du mitbringen musst  Du lebst seit mehreren Jahren in Brasilien. Mit Alltag, Freundeskreis, festen Strukturen. Deutsch auf Muttersprache- oder C1-Niveau. Die Beratung läuft auf Deutsch. Du hast eine eigene Geschichte mit dem Land. Warum bist du gekommen, was hält dich. Du arbeitest selbstständig und bist gut erreichbar — per WhatsApp und im Video-Call.  Was zusätzlich hilft  Portugiesisch-Kenntnisse Englisch fließend Erfahrung in Tourismus, Hospitality oder Beratung Ein eigenes Netzwerk an Hotels, Pousadas, Drivern, Köchen Vertrautheit mit CRM, Google Workspace, WhatsApp Business Zugang zu Menschen, die einen Gast persönlich beeindrucken: Köche, Musiker, Fischer, Capoeira-Lehrer, Flussbootskapitäne im Amazonas  Was wir bieten  Freelance-Vertrag mit flexiblen Stunden. Als Nebentätigkeit gedacht für jemanden, der ohnehin im Land lebt. Vergütung auf Stundenbasis plus Boni für Buchungen und gute Bewertungen. Du baust eine Destination von null auf und prägst, wie wir Brasilien machen. Ein eingespieltes Team im Rücken: Buchungen, Verträge, Tools, Versicherung. Du machst das, was nur du kannst. Langfristige Zusammenarbeit über Jahre.  Eine Frage in deiner Bewerbung: Welchen Ort oder welche Begegnung in Brasilien könntest du möglich machen, die ein Tourist allein nie findet?

Esta não é uma vaga de \"treinar modelo\" nem de \"fazer prompt em chatbot\". E engenharia de plataforma com foco em confiabilidade, observabilidade e auto-recuperação  de agentes autônomos rodando 24/7 em produção, escrevendo código de desenvolvimento, fazendo git push, abrindo PRs, mergeando em omolog, fazendo cherry-pick para produção. O que é o Plataforma Agents de IA  Para você decidir se a vaga te interessa, precisa entender o que vai manter: • Orquestrador:  Le as issues (Jira), identifica issues prontas pra cada stage, dispara agentes (Claude/OpenIA/Gemini/DeepSeek) com contexto rico, valida o resultado, posta comentario na issue, e avanca o status. Roda em servidores Linux, com auto-update. • Agentes (@dev, @qa, @sec, @devops, @pm, @po, @sm, @analyst, @architect, @data-engineer, @ux-design-expert):  cada um com persona, authority matrix definida, skills executáveis e Gates de qualidade. • Rules:  Mais de 60 regras formais que governam o comportamento dos agentes — desde naming conventions até anti-hallucination validation em 7 camadas. Cada rule nasce de um bug real anonimizado em produção e tem detector regex + caso aplicação por agent. • Recovery loops:  quando um stage falha (CI quebra, conflict de cherry-pick, working tree dirty, autocompact thrashing), o orquestrador detecta deterministicamente e redispara o agente em --mode=ci_recovery com contexto enriquecido. Cap de tentativas, anti-oscilação, escalada pra humano quando esgota. • Multi-repo via submodules:  projetos clientes tem 2 a 30+ sub-repos. Vertex orquestra cherry-pick coordenado, dependency promotion cross-issue, working-tree auto-recovery, validação de paridade de coverage Sonar. • Stack:  Bash 5+ (nucleo), Python, Node.js/TypeScript (CLIs auxiliares), gh CLI, jq, integrações HTTP com Jira/GitHub via curl + retry policy. O que você vai fazer  Manutenção do core (40%)  • Manter e evoluir fix de bugs, refatorações controladas, redução de complexidade ciclomática. • Garantir que retry policies (Git, PM API, autocompact, recovery loops) continuem determinísticas e sem custo desnecessário. • Manter as integrações com Jira API (ADF, webhooks, transitions, comments via helper canônico) funcionais frente a mudancas de schema/comportamento. • Operar e melhorar o sistema de telemetria (dashboards de custo por agent/stage/issue). • Diagnosticar incidentes em produção (cliente reporta \"agent crashou em loop\", \"PR criado no repo errado\", \"deploy não promoveu\") e fechar com case study anonimizado + nova rule preventiva. Evolução de agents e rules (35%)  • Criar e refinar rules quando bugs sistemicos forem detectados — cada rule nova segue o template canônico (detector regex, aplicação por agent, caso real anonimizado, antipatterns, checklist). • Calibrar prompts dos agents para reduzir alucinação, scope creep, falsos positivos e ciclos de retrabalho. • Manter o agent-authority.md consistente quando authorities mudarem (ex: @dev ganhou ownership de PR contra homolog em v2.0.146). • Criar/refatorar skills. • Medir impacto de cada rule nova (redução de ciclos de retrabalho, custo USD por issue, leakage rate de bugs Categoria A vs B). Integrações com LLM CLIs (25%)  • Manter compatibilidade com mudanças de breaking change dos provedores (Claude Code, OpenAI CLI, Gemini CLI, DeepSeek direct). • Avaliar e integrar novos providers/modelos quando custo-benefício mudar (ex: DeepSeek-Reasoner para recovery loops, Haiku para classificação). • Otimizar custo: identificar stages onde modelo menor resolve. • Implementar fallbacks quando um provider está em outage (ja existe retry transient; expandir cobertura). • Trabalhar com tokenização, context windows, autocompact thrashing detection — entender as falhas reais de cada modelo, não a teoria. O que esperamos de você  Stack técnica — obrigatório  • Bash/Shell avançado e Linux  — você e confortável lendo e escrevendo 500+ linhas de bash com set -euo pipefail, traps, subshells, file locks, jq, awk, sed, heredocs, parameter expansion avançada. Não tem medo de poll.sh. Sabe diferenciar ( ) de ((  e porque importa. • Node.js / TypeScript  — escreve TS com strict mode, entende quando não  usar Node (ex: lógica de orquestração crítica fica em bash justamente porque e mais previsível que async JS). • Git e GitHub avançado  — cherry-pick com -m 1, submodules, gh pr create/merge/edit/list --search, git revert, git rebase --autosquash, resolução de conflicts nao-triviais, branch protection rules, GitHub Actions workflows. • Prompt engineering aplicado a agentes autônomos  — você já calibrou prompts em produção, sabe que \"diga ao modelo o que não  fazer\" raramente funciona, entende o efeito de exemplos few-shot vs zero-shot, e já debugou ao menos uma vez porque um agente está \"alucinando\" um PR que não criou. Experiência  • 5+ anos de engenharia de software produzindo sistemas em produção. • Pelo menos 1 ano com agentes autônomos / orquestração de LLMs  em ambiente real (não bootcamp, não side project) — você sabe a diferença entre \"rodou no demo\" e \"rodou em prod 24/7 sem humano\". • Histórico comprovado de manter sistemas legados com debt técnico — você não quer \"reescrever do zero\". • Inglês técnico fluente para leitura/escrita (documentação, issues, comentários de código em inglês obrigatórios; comunicação verbal pode ser PT/EN/ZH dependendo do time). Mentalidade  • Determinismo > magia.  Você prefere uma regex feia em bash que sempre funciona a um ML model elegante que falha em 5% dos casos. Em orquestração de agentes, 5% de falha = produto inviável. • Forensics sobre intuição.  Antes de propor solução, você lê o log, o diff, a issue real do cliente. Não inventa hipótese. • Documentação executável.  Quando você cria uma rule nova, ela tem detector regex que pode rodar em CI. \"Documentei em texto\" não basta. • Empatia por agente.  Você consegue ler um prompt de 8k tokens e identificar onde o modelo vai se confundir, por que, e o que ajustar. Diferenciais  • Experiencia com Claude Agent SDK, OpenAI Agents SDK, LangGraph ou frameworks de orquestração equivalentes. • Já implementou ou manteve sistemas de retry policy + backoff exponencial + circuit breaker  em integrações com APIs externas instáveis. • Já trabalhou com monorepos via submodules  (nao apenas Nx/Turborepo) e entende os trade-offs. • Contribuições open-source em projetos relacionados (CLIs, dev tooling, agent frameworks). • Experiencia com DevOps em servidores Linux dedicados  (não apenas k8s/cloud managed): systemd, cron, logrotate, monitoring com ferramentas leves. • Familiaridade com conventional commits, semantic-release, gitflow trifásico  (feature → homolog → main com cherry-pick). • Já escreveu post-mortem público / case study técnico que outras pessoas referenciam. Benefícios  • VR/VA – Flash Benefícios • Assistência Médica – Bradesco Saúde • Assistência Odontológica – Bradesco • Programa de Orientação Pessoal – C4Life • Day Off de Aniversário • TotalPass • Parcerias educacionais (FIAP e Alura)

title: Country Manager- Brazil
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Country Manager- Brazil em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

About VelaFi  At VelaFi, we're building the future of global financial infrastructure. As a stablecoin-powered platform, we help businesses move money across borders faster, more securely, and more efficiently by connecting local banking rails, global payment networks, and leading stablecoin ecosystems through regulated entities across Latin America, Asia, and the United States. Our mission extends beyond payments—we are creating the infrastructure that enables businesses to operate confidently in an increasingly connected world. By combining innovative technology with regulatory excellence, we simplify complex global financial operations while maintaining the highest standards of compliance, security, and reliability. Position Overview  VelaFi is seeking an experienced Chief Executive Officer (CEO) – Brazil  to lead the company's Brazilian operations and serve as the statutory executive responsible for the local VASP entity. Reporting directly to the Global Executive Leadership Team, the CEO will be responsible for the overall leadership, strategic direction, regulatory engagement, commercial growth, and operational performance of VelaFi Brazil. This individual will play a critical role in establishing the company's presence in Brazil, leading local market expansion, fostering relationships with regulators and financial institutions, and ensuring compliance with Brazilian regulatory requirements. The ideal candidate combines executive leadership experience, strong commercial acumen, operational excellence, and the ability to lead a highly regulated financial services organization in a fast-growing global fintech environment. The CEO will also play a pivotal role in leading VelaFi Brazil's regulatory establishment, including executive oversight of the BACEN registration process and collaboration on the company's Brazil VASP licensing process, working closely with Compliance, Legal, and global leadership.  Location  Remote – Brazil  Candidates must reside in Brazil and be legally authorized to work in the country. Periodic travel within Brazil and internationally may be required. Key Responsibilities  Executive Leadership  Lead the overall strategy, growth, and operational performance of VelaFi Brazil. Build and develop the local leadership team and organizational structure. Establish operational excellence while ensuring alignment with global company objectives. Drive execution across Commercial, Operations, Finance, Compliance, and Product functions.  Regulatory & Corporate Governance  Serve as the primary executive representative before Brazilian regulatory authorities. Maintain strong relationships with the Central Bank of Brazil (BACEN) , financial institutions, banking partners, and other regulatory stakeholders. Lead the company's BACEN registration process, ensuring timely execution of regulatory requirements and coordination with internal and external stakeholders.  Provide executive oversight and collaborate closely with Compliance, Legal, and global leadership throughout the Brazil VASP licensing process, supporting regulatory submissions, licensing milestones, and ongoing compliance efforts.  Ensure ongoing compliance with applicable VASP, financial services, and corporate governance requirements. Support ongoing regulatory reporting, licensing renewals, and corporate governance initiatives.  Commercial Growth & Strategic Partnerships  Develop and execute the company's go-to-market strategy in Brazil. Build strategic partnerships with banks, payment service providers (PSPs), fintechs, enterprise customers, and ecosystem partners. Identify new business opportunities and support revenue growth. Represent VelaFi at executive meetings, conferences, and industry events.  Cross-Functional Leadership  Partner closely with Finance, Compliance, Treasury, Product, Operations, Legal, and Commercial teams. Foster collaboration across global teams located in LATAM, APAC, and North America. Drive organizational alignment and operational efficiency across all business functions.  Organizational Development  Recruit, mentor, and develop high-performing teams. Promote a culture of accountability, innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement. Support workforce planning and organizational scaling as the business grows.  Qualifications  Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Economics, Law, or a related field. MBA or other advanced degree preferred. 10+ years of executive leadership experience within fintech, banking, payments, financial services, or related industries. Proven experience leading business operations and organizational growth. Strong understanding of Brazil's financial services and regulatory environment. Experience working with regulators, banking institutions, and executive stakeholders. Experience leading or supporting regulatory licensing, authorization, or registration processes with Brazilian financial regulators (including BACEN or VASP frameworks) is strongly preferred.  Exceptional leadership, communication, and decision-making skills. Professional proficiency in Portuguese and English.  Nice to Have  Experience in fintech, payments, digital assets, stablecoins, or blockchain technology. Experience launching or scaling financial services businesses in Brazil. Existing relationships with Brazilian regulators, financial institutions, and payment providers. Experience working within multinational or global organizations. Experience with cross-border payments and treasury infrastructure. Experience leading or supporting BACEN registration, financial institution licensing, or Brazil VASP authorization initiatives.   Regulatory Requirements (Brazil VASP)  Candidates selected for this position must be eligible to satisfy applicable Brazilian regulatory requirements, including: Be legally authorized to reside and work in Brazil. Possess the qualifications, experience, and professional competence required to perform executive responsibilities. Successfully complete background checks and regulatory due diligence. Be eligible to serve as an executive of a regulated financial institution under applicable Brazilian laws. Have no disqualifying criminal convictions, financial crimes, or regulatory restrictions that would prevent appointment.  Why Join VelaFi?  At VelaFi, we're building the future of global financial infrastructure. As a stablecoin-powered platform, we connect local banking rails, global payment networks, and digital asset infrastructure to enable faster, more secure, and more efficient cross-border money movement. Joining VelaFi means playing a foundational leadership role in establishing our regulated presence in Brazil while helping shape one of the company's most strategic growth markets. You'll work alongside global executive leadership to build a scalable business, lead critical regulatory initiatives, and help create the financial infrastructure powering the next generation of global payments. Guided by our values of Ingenuity, Accountability, Excellence, Care, and a Global Mindset , we empower our leaders to solve meaningful challenges, take ownership, and build lasting impact across global financial markets. Equal Employment Opportunity  VelaFi is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and respectful workplace where everyone has the opportunity to thrive. We make employment decisions based on qualifications, merit, and business needs, and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

Diferencial:   Experiência com Azure DevOps ou GitHub Actions para CI/CD de soluções de IA (MLOps light); Familiaridade com Python para prototipagem rápida, scripts de indexação ou integração com SDKs de IA; Conhecimento de Azure Functions ou Logic Apps para automação serverless; Experiência com Azure API Management (APIM) para expor e governar endpoints de IA; Familiaridade com conectores customizados e extensões de agente (Copilot extensibility); Conhecimento de Azure SQL, Cosmos DB ou PostgreSQL para persistência em soluções de IA; Experiência com Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) ou containerização de modelos/aplicações; Familiaridade com monitoramento de IA: Azure Monitor, Application Insights, logging de prompts/respostas; Certificação AI-102 (Azure AI Engineer Associate); Certificação PL-100 / PL-200 (Power Platform); Certificação AZ-204 (Azure Developer Associate);  Modelo de atuação: Home Office, mas precisa ter disponibilidade para viajar esporadicamente; Contratação CLT O que oferecemos?  Vale Refeição ou Alimentação; Assistência Médica e Assistência Odontológica; Auxílio creche; Convênio com Farmácia; Parcerias com Universidades e Escolas de Idiomas; Parceria de descontos com Seguro Auto e Residência; Gympass; Seguro de Vida;  Promovemos um ambiente de trabalho inclusivo e acolhedor. Não fazemos distinção por raça, cor, religião, gênero, orientação sexual, nacionalidade, deficiência ou idade. Todas as candidaturas serão consideradas. O seu interesse em participar deste processo seletivo, automaticamente consente, autoriza e concorda que a PSM COMPANY, no papel de CONTROLADORA, tome decisões referentes ao tratamento de seus dados pessoais para esta finalidade específica, em conformidade com a Lei nº 13.709 – Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados Pessoais (LGPD).

title: Professor de francês
description:
Empresa está contratando Professor de francês em campinas. Veja detalhes e envie seu currículo.

Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!   Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!  A Idioma Independente , referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada. Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.  Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco.  Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível. *Esta não é uma vaga CLT*  O que oferecemos?  Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos  de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados . Mentorias semanais  com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais. Plataforma exclusiva  para acompanhamento das aulas. Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar. Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade. Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser). Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas. Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.  Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?  Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.  Necessário:  Maior de 18 anos , fluente em Português e outro idioma. Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais  para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar. Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde. Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.  O diferencial?  Aqui você é mais que um professor. Own and orchestrate end-to-end responses to RFx (RFI / RFP / RFQ), including solution design, compliance and traceability matrices, win themes, technical narratives, effort and Bill-of-Materials estimation, assumptions, and risk identification – driving on-time, high-quality, fully compliant submissions. Design and articulate end-to-end OSS solution architectures spanning Service Assurance, Service Orchestration & Fulfilment, Inventory, and closed-loop automation, mapping the Rakuten Symphony portfolio to operator pain points and measurable business outcomes. Position and demonstrate the Service Assurance portfolio – fault, performance, and service-quality management; AI/ML-driven anomaly detection, alarm correlation and noise reduction; automated root-cause analysis; and predictive, proactive assurance – including customer-experience and network-slice assurance for 5G Standalone. Develop solutions, value cases, and demonstrations around SMO (Service Management & Orchestration) and RIC (RAN Intelligent Controller) platforms, including the Non-RT RIC and rApps (R1, A1 interfaces) and the Near-RT RIC and xApps (E2 interface), addressing use cases such as RAN energy savings, traffic steering, QoE optimization, massive-MIMO and interference management, and anomaly detection. Champion network automation and autonomy – closed-loop operations, intent-based and intent-driven management, and the journey toward TM Forum Level 4 autonomous networks – and translate these capabilities into concrete, quantifiable value propositions for customers. Lead technical proofs-of-concept, lab trials, product demonstrations, and solution integration and validation, tailoring demo environments to each customer’s specific use cases, KPIs, and success criteria. Be responsible and accountable for authoring technical solution documents, high-level designs, design proposals, sizing and Bill-of-Materials, and TCO / ROI models that withstand customer and third-party technical scrutiny. Serve as the trusted technical advisor to customers and prospects – running discovery workshops, executive briefings, and technical deep-dives – and manage technical stakeholder relationships from engineering and operations teams up to C-level. Work cross-functionally with internal teams – Product Management, Engineering, Delivery / Professional Services, Commercial, and Bid Management – and with external parties – operators, system integrators, hyperscalers, and O-RAN / ecosystem partners – to assemble winning and deliverable solutions. Generate thought-leadership content – white papers, blogs, reference architectures, and webinars – and represent Rakuten Symphony at industry events and standards / community forums such as TM Forum and the O-RAN ALLIANCE. Stay ahead of telecom market trends – Open RAN, 5G and 5G-Advanced, cloud-native CNFs and Kubernetes, observability and telemetry, GenAI and agentic AI for operations, and the shift toward data-driven, autonomous networks – and bring that insight into customer conversations and internal strategy.  Requirements:  Must-have demonstrable skills & expertise:  Exceptional verbal and written communication, executive presentation, and storytelling skills, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear business value. Proven hands-on pre-sales and solution-architecture experience in the OSS domain for mobile operators and/or telecommunication vendors, including ownership of RFx responses and customer-facing technical engagements. Deep, demonstrable expertise across the Service Assurance domain – fault, performance, and service-quality management, customer-experience management, and AI/ML-driven assurance (anomaly detection, correlation, automated root-cause analysis, and predictive / proactive assurance). Strong working knowledge of network automation and autonomy – closed-loop assurance and orchestration, intent-based operations, and the TM Forum Autonomous Networks framework (Levels 0–5). Familiarity with O-RAN architecture and SMO / RIC platforms, including the Non-RT RIC (rApps, R1, A1), the Near-RT RIC (xApps, E2), and the O1 / O2 management interfaces. Exposure to public clouds (GCP, Azure, and AWS) and to cloud service models (IaaS, PaaS, DBaaS), with an appreciation of hybrid / multi-cloud and O-Cloud deployment models. Working knowledge of TM Forum standards and Open APIs / Open Digital Architecture (ODA), and of data and observability technologies (streaming pipelines, telemetry, and data lakes). Demonstrated ability to lead and coordinate virtual, cross-functional bid and solution teams across multiple geographies and time zones, and to manage internal and external stakeholders. Willingness to travel as required.

Suporte Pós-Venda  • Tratar prontamente as reclamações e o feedback dos clientes. • Garantir elevados níveis de satisfação dos clientes por meio de um serviço de pós-venda eficiente. title: Project Manager
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Project Manager em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

Ten16 Creative is looking for a mid-level Project Manager based in Brazil to help keep our creative work clear, organized, and moving forward. Ten16 is a creative partner for technology-driven companies, helping teams turn complex products into clear, market-ready brand, campaign, design, web, video, and motion experiences. Our clients operate across areas such as AI, SaaS, gaming, entertainment, consumer electronics, connected hardware, and B2B technology. This is a remote contractor position for someone who is experienced enough to manage multiple moving pieces with confidence, but still hands-on, adaptable, and eager to grow with a fast-moving creative team. The right person will bring structure to creative work without slowing it down. They will help coordinate timelines, deliverables, client communication, internal reviews, production details, and day-to-day follow-through across projects that often involve strategy, design, writing, motion, video, web, and campaign development. About Ten16 CreativeTen16 Creative is a global creative studio with roots in the United States and São Paulo. We help tech-driven companies make complex products easier to understand, trust, and bring to market. Our work spans brand identity, campaign development, design systems, web design, presentations, marketing assets, video, motion, 3D animation, AI-powered production, and creative leadership. We work with companies that need a creative partner who can bring clarity, consistency, and structure to sophisticated products. Our clients have included technology, AI, SaaS, gaming, entertainment, and consumer electronics brands, with representative work across companies and projects in various tech-driven spaces.  About the RoleThe Project Manager will be responsible for helping Ten16 plan, coordinate, and deliver creative projects from kickoff through final delivery. This person will work closely with creative directors, designers, producers, writers, motion teams, developers, and clients to make sure everyone understands what needs to happen, when it needs to happen, and what is required to deliver excellent work. This role is ideal for someone who has already worked in an agency, creative studio, production company, marketing team, or digital product environment and understands how creative work moves from brief to execution. The role does not require senior-level account leadership, but it does require organization, fluent English and Portuguese communication skills, and the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.  You will manage active project timelines and ensure that milestones, deliverables, meetings, and reviews are clearly documented and communicated. You will help turn creative scopes into practical schedules, making sure that internal team members understand priorities and that clients understand what is needed from them to keep projects moving. You will coordinate daily and weekly project activity across brand, design, web, video, motion, campaign, and presentation work. This includes assigning or tracking tasks, following up on open items, preparing meeting agendas, documenting decisions, and making sure feedback is captured accurately. You will also help maintain project management tools, shared folders, project boards, calendars, and production documents so the team always has a reliable source of truth. You will support client-facing communication in English with professionalism and clarity. This may include sending status updates, recapping meetings, organizing feedback, preparing for presentations, and helping the team stay ahead of deadlines. Because Ten16 works with technology-driven companies, you should be comfortable working on projects where the subject matter may be complex, technical, or still evolving. You will help protect the quality of the work by making sure deliverables are complete, organized, properly labeled, and ready for review or delivery. You will not be expected to creative-direct the work, but you should have a strong eye for detail and enough creative production experience to recognize when something is missing, unclear, or not ready to send. QualificationsThe ideal candidate has approximately 3–5 years of experience in project management, creative production, account coordination, marketing operations, agency operations, or a related role. They should have experience managing creative deliverables and coordinating cross-functional teams in a remote environment. They must be located in Brazil and must be fluent in both Portuguese and English. English fluency is essential because the role will involve written and spoken communication with U.S.-based team members and clients. Portuguese fluency is equally important for collaboration with Brazil-based team members and vendors.

O foco desta posição é criar uma operação de projetos eficiente e escalável, traduzindo complexidade operacional em resultados claros para clientes Enterprise e para a alta liderança, enquanto desenvolve uma cultura de projetos orientada a resultados em toda a organização. Quais serão suas principais responsabilidades comoPMO por aqui?  Governança e Padronização  Definir e padronizar metodologias de gestão de projetos (Ágil, Tradicional/Preditivo ou Híbrido) em toda a organização. Desenvolver modelos de documentos, relatórios, fluxos de aprovação e ferramentas obrigatórias para os gerentes de projeto. Auditar projetos periodicamente para garantir conformidade com normas e critérios estabelecidos. Monitorar indicadores globais de saúde do portfólio (ROI, desvio de prazo, controle de orçamento). Reportar o status consolidado de todas as iniciativas para a alta liderança por meio de dashboards e relatórios executivos.  Gestão de Recursos e Riscos  Otimizar a alocação de profissionais, equipes e orçamentos entre projetos para evitar gargalos. Identificar e mitigar riscos interdependentes que afetam múltiplos projetos simultaneamente, traçando planos de contingência corporativos. Intervir na resolução de conflitos por recursos entre diferentes departamentos, inclusive organizando a prática de gestão de partes interessadas, envolvendo clientes externos.  Desenvolvimento de Pessoas e Cultura  Treinar gerentes de projeto e lideranças táticas nas melhores práticas de mercado. Promover uma cultura de eficiência, entrega de valor e foco em resultados por toda a estrutura. Gerenciar, capacitar e motivar a equipe técnica e funcional, promovendo um ambiente saudável e de melhoria contínua.  Para que você seja considerado(a) para a posição, é necessário apresentar:  Certificação PMP (Project Management Professional) ou PMO-CP (PMO Certified Practitioner). Inglês avançado/fluente (projetos globais e atendimento a clientes internacionais). Forte experiência em Gestão de Projetos, PMO ou Liderança, incluindo coordenação de programas, gestão de portfólios múltiplos (PPM) e interface com C-level. Experiência em sistemas no modelo SaaS. Domínio de frameworks ágeis (Scrum e Kanban) e metodologias tradicionais (Waterfall). Experiência com ferramentas de gestão de portfólio (Clarity PPM, Asana Enterprise ou MS Project). Capacidade de Storytelling com Dados  — transformar planilhas complexas em apresentações com narrativa lógica e plano de ação proposto. Vivência em Change Management : análise de impacto cultural, mapeamento de stakeholders e planos de comunicação. Ensino superior completo.  Nossos olhos irão brilhar, se você:  Espanhol avançado/fluente (diferencial para atendimento a clientes Latam). Experiência com ferramentas de BI e criação de dashboards executivos (Power BI ou similares). Experiência em empresas de tecnologia de alto crescimento ou scale-ups.  O que oferecemos:  Modelo Remote First : trabalhe de onde quiser de forma remota, mas caso queira, poderá visitar nossa sede localizada no coração de Belo Horizonte; Equipamentos de trabalho : disponibilizamos o principal que você precisa para poder trabalhar com tranquilidade; Jornada de trabalho flexível : aqui priorizamos entregas de qualidade, e não tempo desprendido; Cartão de benefício flexível Caju : valores mensais para você usar da forma que quiser (Refeição, alimentação, home office, mobilidade e cultura); Plano de saúde e odontológico;  Day off de aniversário : tire um dia para curtir e relaxar em até 90 dias após seu aniversário; Licença maternidade e paternidade estendida;  Gamificação em nossa plataforma de engajamento : compute netcoins que serão revertidos em prêmios a cada trimestre; Educalex : benefício de incentivo à educação para a realização de cursos, workshops, palestras, aquisição de livros e mais! Stock Options : possibilidade de adquirir ações da netLex de acordo com seu desenvolvimento em nosso plano de carreiras.

Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!   Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!  A Idioma Independente , referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada. Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.  Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco.  Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível. *Esta não é uma vaga CLT*  O que oferecemos?  Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos  de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados . Mentorias semanais  com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais. Plataforma exclusiva  para acompanhamento das aulas. Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar. Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade. Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser). Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas. Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.  Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?  Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.  Necessário:  Maior de 18 anos , fluente em Português e outro idioma. Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais  para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar. Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde. Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.  O diferencial?  Aqui você é mais que um professor.  Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos. Esta não é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora. Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas. Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii  com certeza é o seu lugar. Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas.  Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos! O que eu faço?  Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as  Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio. QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?  Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês. Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano. Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.  Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores. Seja diferente, seja independente

title: Portuguese Language Expert
description:

We are looking for detail-oriented Freelance AI Trainers – Audio to support high-impact Generative AI data annotation projects involving PII identification and content risk assessment on raw audio inputs. In this role, you will listen to and annotate raw audio content to identify personally identifiable information, assess risk signals, evaluate AI-generated outputs where applicable, and apply detailed project guidelines with precision. You will help create high-quality ground truth data used to train and improve advanced AI models. This is a flexible, freelance engagement suited to individuals who want project-based work rather than a fixed weekly schedule. It requires strong listening comprehension, mature judgment, attention to detail, and the ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment where guidelines may evolve frequently. Key Responsibilities  As an AI Trainer – Audio, you will: Review and annotate raw audio content, including spoken conversations, calls, and other audio recordings. Identify, classify, and assess personally identifiable information, sensitive data, and privacy-related risks conveyed through audio. Perform risk assessment on audio content involving safety, policy compliance, sensitive topics, and contextual ambiguity. Evaluate AI model outputs derived from audio for correctness, completeness, relevance, risk classification, and guideline adherence, where applicable. Apply complex, frequently updated annotation guidelines consistently and with sound judgment. Handle potentially sensitive, unsafe, or policy-sensitive audio content responsibly and professionally. Manage own schedule and task throughput within agreed project deadlines and quality expectations. Escalate ambiguous cases, guideline gaps, tooling issues, and edge cases to project leads or quality teams. Collaborate remotely with Project Managers, Quality Analysts, and technical teams to improve annotation quality and workflow efficiency.  Required Language Proficiency  Candidates must demonstrate CEFR C1+ equivalent proficiency in their working language (English or the applicable target language). Bilingual proficiency is not required for this role. Proficiency is required in: Listening / Understanding (primary requirement, given the audio-based nature of the task) Reading comprehension (for guideline interpretation and task instructions) Basic written composition (for annotation notes and escalation of edge cases)  The role requires the ability to understand nuanced spoken language, accents, cultural context, idiomatic expressions, policy-sensitive language, and subtle differences in meaning conveyed through audio. Required Experience  The ideal candidate should have prior hands-on experience in one or more of the following annotation areas: PII identification or privacy annotation Risk assessment or content safety annotation Audio transcript annotation or audio-based data labeling Named Entity Recognition or entity classification LLM response evaluation AI chatbot evaluation Policy-based content moderation Sensitive content classification Gen AI or LLM training data creation  Candidates must have previously worked on annotation projects requiring strict guideline adherence, ambiguity resolution, and quality-focused decision-making. Skills and Competencies  We are looking for candidates who have: Excellent listening comprehension and audio interpretation ability in their working language. Strong analytical thinking and decision-making skills. A close attention to detail and consistency. Ability to interpret complex, evolving guidelines and apply them accurately. Comfort working with sensitive, ambiguous, or policy-heavy audio content. Strong understanding of tone, context, and language nuance as conveyed through speech. Ability to work independently in a remote, flexible-hours setup. Familiarity with annotation tools, quality workflows, and productivity tracking. Good communication skills for raising clarifications, documenting edge cases, and collaborating with distributed teams.  Qualifications  Bachelor's degree, diploma, or equivalent educational qualification preferred. Minimum 1–2 years of relevant annotation experience in AI/ML, Gen AI, audio data, content moderation, PII, risk assessment, or related domains. Prior experience working on Large Language Model training, evaluation, or data annotation projects is strongly preferred. Exposure to audio-based workflows, trust and safety operations, or privacy-focused annotation will be an advantage.  Engagement Terms  This is a freelance, non-binding engagement — there is no guaranteed or fixed weekly hour commitment on either side. Work volume and availability windows will be communicated on a project/task basis, with flexibility for both iMerit and the freelancer to scale up or down. Compensation is structured on a per-hour basis, aligned to project pricing terms, rather than a fixed salary. Freelancers are expected to maintain agreed quality and turnaround standards for the tasks they accept.  What We Offer  Flexible, remote freelance opportunity with global project teams. Exposure to cutting-edge Gen AI and LLM data annotation projects. Opportunity to work on meaningful AI safety, privacy, and model improvement initiatives. Structured project guidelines, quality support, and continuous learning opportunities. A collaborative environment focused on precision, accountability, and responsible AI development.  Application Note  This role is suitable for candidates who are highly analytical, quality-focused, and comfortable working with complex audio annotation guidelines on a flexible, freelance basis. Bilingual proficiency is not required. Prior experience in PII, risk assessment, audio annotation, or LLM evaluation is essential.

This is not English for occasional meetings: you will run interviews, facilitate trainings, handle sensitive conversations and negotiate with US search firms in English, daily 8-12 years of generalist HR experience Experience at coordinator-to-manager level Strong vendor management skills: BPOs, recruiting agencies, development consultancies Autonomy to operate without a ready-made structure and maturity to work directly with founders Availability to work across time zones: the India window falls in the Brazilian morning, and the US window in the afternoon  Nice-to-haves  Experience supporting internationally distributed teams Familiarity with the architecture, engineering or construction (AEC) industry Prior experience as a first HR hire or building a People function from scratch  Selection Process  1.	Apply to the opportunity, submitting the form with your CV 2.	Screening: English and communication assessment (video) 3.	Technical challenge 4.	Interviews with leadership 5.	Offer Why join Downtown?  Role with direct business impact Work directly with founders Fast-moving, low-bureaucracy culture with real autonomy High growth opportunity as the company scales  PS: why Brazil? Excelente comunicação para interação com áreas técnicas e de negócio. Capacidade de atuar em projetos estratégicos de alto impacto para a organização. title: Client Success & Onboarding Specialist (Marketing Agency)
description:
