Client Onboarding Specialist (Marketing Agency)  Type: Part-Time (15–20 hours/week to start, with potential to increase based on client volume)  Schedule: US business hours overlap required  About the Role  We are looking for an experienced Client Onboarding Specialist to join a fast-growing US marketing agency. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a client-facing environment, enjoys solving complex platform access issues, and takes ownership of every onboarding from kickoff to successful launch. As the first point of contact after a client signs, you'll guide new clients through the onboarding process, secure access across multiple marketing platforms, troubleshoot technical roadblocks, and coordinate with internal teams to ensure campaigns can launch successfully. Beyond technical expertise, we're looking for someone who communicates with confidence, builds trust quickly, adapts to different client personalities, and genuinely advocates for clients throughout the onboarding journey. You'll play a critical role in creating a positive first impression and setting the foundation for long-term client relationships. Key Responsibilities  Lead onboarding calls with new clients and confidently guide them through the onboarding process. Own the onboarding process from kickoff through successful campaign launch. Obtain access to all required marketing platforms, business assets, and tracking tools. Assist clients with permissions, account setup, payment methods, verification processes, and platform configurations. Troubleshoot platform access issues across Meta, Google, TikTok, Shopify, Klaviyo, and other marketing tools. Submit support tickets, appeals, and follow up proactively until issues are resolved. Coordinate with internal teams to ensure a seamless transition after onboarding. Identify onboarding roadblocks and independently drive them to resolution. Create clear documentation of client access, permissions, and onboarding progress. Maintain organized records of credentials, platform access, and onboarding status. Deliver an outstanding onboarding experience while building trust and confidence with every client. Continuously identify opportunities to improve onboarding processes and operational efficiency.  Requirements  2+ years of experience in client onboarding, account management, client success, agency operations, or similar client-facing roles. Previous experience working in a multi-service digital marketing agency is required. Fluent English with excellent verbal and written communication skills. Experience leading client onboarding calls and managing client relationships. Strong customer service mindset with the ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical clients. Excellent organizational and time management skills. Strong problem-solving abilities with a proactive, solution-oriented mindset. Ability to work independently, prioritize multiple onboardings, and follow through until completion.  Technical Experience  Hands-on experience managing access and permissions across several of the following platforms:  Meta Business Manager Google Ads, Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager, Google Merchant Center, Google Business Profile TikTok Business Manager Klaviyo, Shopify, WordPress, Squarespace, Wix, Webflow, Framer  What We're Looking For  Outstanding communication and interpersonal skills. Ownership mentality—you take responsibility until the problem is solved. Solution-oriented thinker who brings recommendations, not just problems. Strong emotional intelligence and patience when working with different client personalities. Confident leading conversations with clients and setting clear expectations. Highly organized and detail-oriented. Proactive, resourceful, and comfortable navigating ambiguity. Operational mindset with a passion for improving processes. Professional, approachable, and confident—you'll be the first impression clients have of our agency.  Nice to Have  Experience with GoHighLevel (GHL), HubSpot, ClickUp, Asana, or similar tools. Basic knowledge of Google Analytics or marketing tracking implementations. Experience with WooCommerce or other e-commerce platforms. Familiarity with POS systems or online ordering platforms. Digital marketing background with an understanding of paid media operations. Spanish or Portuguese proficiency is a plus.

title: Senior Technical Product Manager
description:

*Please not that this is a 8month temp-to-perm independent contract About hirework s hireworks is building a community of top talent in key international markets by unlocking unparalleled access to positions at leading U.S. based companies. As your employer, hireworks will ensure you have a seamless interview, onboarding, and employee experience - providing ongoing support and resources along the way. Established in 2023, hireworks is forging corp-to-corp relationships with leading U.S. based organizations looking to grow their teams with best-in-class talent around the world. Working with hireworks means unlocking access to a network of local peers and mentors and career opportunities through our client network. About Our Client & The Engagemen t Our client is a premier AI consulting group that builds serious, production-grade systems for companies ready to operationalize artificial intelligence across their business. They eschew gimmicks and prototypes, focusing instead on delivering custom AI that integrates seamlessly into operations to drive measurable results. Their work automates high-effort workflows, launches AI-powered product lines, and transforms internal data into structured, usable assets—ranging from custom-trained models to intelligent agents that reason across complex business logic. Their diverse clientele spans education, financial services, engineering, healthcare, and defense About the Engagement  A multi-component platform build for an education-sector client: a cloud-native system that ingests school and rostering data into one canonical record, governs access down to the row and field, fronts it behind a single access layer, builds audiences from it, and delivers multi-channel communications to families at scale. It ships as five interlocking components, each with its own scope: a canonical data integration and migration platform; a capability-based access-control service; a unified API access layer over the core; an audience service; and an event-driven communications platform with consent and reporting. We are hiring two senior, interchangeable technical PMs. Each owns one or more components end to end and flexes across all five. You won't inherit a finished roadmap: you'll author scope, sequence delivery across interdependent teams, steer architecture with engineering, and run sign-off and rollout with the client.  What You Will Own  Turn ambiguous, architecture-heavy scope into sequenced roadmaps with clear milestones and acceptance criteria. Govern scope and change as designs evolve through discovery, validation, and performance testing. Hold the contracts and sequencing across deeply interdependent component teams. Run client sign-off on schemas, policy models, SLAs, and migration cutover gates. Define and track delivery metrics: success and lag rates, latency, dead-letters, and reconciliation tolerances. Own phased rollout and migration per client: shadow mode, dual-run, cutover, and rollback. Treat compliance as product requirements: FERPA, COPPA, GDPR/CCPA/CPRA, TCPA, SOC 2, and data residency. Partner with the client's product and engineering teams on PRDs, governance rules, and vendor selection.  Responsibilities  Own one or more components end to end: scope, roadmap, sequencing, risk, and client sign-off. Author each component's scope and architecture narrative, and shepherd changes through client review. Keep the interfaces between components coherent so dependent teams stay unblocked. Set and hold acceptance criteria and quality gates for production-grade delivery. Drive the migration and rollout playbook as reusable tooling: discovery, mapping, dual-run, cutover, rollback. Translate between client business rules and engineering trade-offs: delivery semantics, replay, caching, latency. Track delivery health against SLAs and surface risk early with clear recommendations. Operate as a peer to senior engineering and client leadership in design reviews and sign-offs.  Required Experience  8+ years in product management, several as a senior, principal, or staff technical PM on platform or data-infrastructure products. Track record shipping complex backend or platform products to production at scale (data, API, identity/auth, segmentation, or messaging). Strong technical fluency: data modeling, event-driven systems, API contracts, authorization models, and cloud infra (GCP, AWS, or Azure). Proven ownership of scope and change management on ambiguous, evolving engagements. Cross-team dependency and interface management across interlocking services. Strong stakeholder management; able to run and close schema, policy, and SLA sign-offs. Large-scale data migration and phased rollout: dual-run, shadow mode, cutover, rollback. Credible with engineers on distributed-systems trade-offs: idempotency, delivery semantics, replay, backpressure, latency.  Bonus  EdTech, SIS, or student-rostering experience. Depth in data integration, access control (ABAC/RBAC), API gateways, segmentation, or messaging platforms. Hands-on with a GCP-native stack (Dataflow/Beam, Spanner, Pub/Sub, BigQuery, Cloud Run, Terraform). Senior consulting or client-services delivery experience. An engineering or technical background earlier in your career. Built reusable migration or onboarding tooling that runs per client.  Benefits  hireworks is cultivating a growing community of top talent across Colombia, Argentina or Bulgaria. In addition to unlocking access to positions at top tier U.S. based companies, we offer a variety of benefits to enhance your experience: Competitive Pay  – compensation that reflects your experience and accomplishments. Remote Flexibility  – work from anywhere within your local country (Colombia or Argentina), with the option to use co-working space as available locally. Paid Time Off  – ample vacation days to rest and recharge. Public Holidays  – all local federal holidays are fully paid days off.

title: OSS PreSales Architect
description:
Nova vaga disponível para OSS PreSales Architect em campinas. Saiba mais sobre essa oportunidade.

Role: Pre-Sales Solution Architect Location: LATM Region Responsibilities: • Act as the lead OSS solution architect across the full pre-sales lifecycle – from opportunity qualification and technical discovery through proof-of-concept, proposal, and contract award – partnering closely with Sales leadership to shape, qualify, and grow the regional pipeline. • Own and orchestrate end-to-end responses to RFx (RFI / RFP / RFQ), including solution design, compliance and traceability matrices, win themes, technical narratives, effort and Bill-of-Materials estimation, assumptions, and risk identification – driving on-time, high- quality, fully compliant submissions. • Design and articulate end-to-end OSS solution architectures spanning Service Assurance, Service Orchestration & Fulfilment, Inventory, and closed-loop automation, mapping theCompany portfolio to operator pain points and measurable business outcomes. • Position and demonstrate the Service Assurance portfolio – fault, performance, and service- quality management; AI/ML-driven anomaly detection, alarm correlation and noise reduction; automated root-cause analysis; and predictive, proactive assurance – including customer-experience and network-slice assurance for 5G Standalone. • Develop solutions, value cases, and demonstrations around SMO (Service Management & Orchestration) and RIC (RAN Intelligent Controller) platforms, including the Non-RT RIC and rApps (R1, A1 interfaces) and the Near-RT RIC and xApps (E2 interface), addressing use cases such as RAN energy savings, traffic steering, QoE optimization, massive-MIMO and interference management, and anomaly detection. • Champion network automation and autonomy – closed-loop operations, intent-based and intent-driven management, and the journey toward TM Forum Level 4 autonomous networks – and translate these capabilities into concrete, quantifiable value propositions for customers. • Lead technical proofs-of-concept, lab trials, product demonstrations, and solution integration and validation, tailoring demo environments to each customer’s specific use cases, KPIs, and success criteria. • Be responsible and accountable for authoring technical solution documents, high-level designs, design proposals, sizing and Bill-of-Materials, and TCO / ROI models that withstand customer and third-party technical scrutiny. • Serve as the trusted technical advisor to customers and prospects – running discovery workshops, executive briefings, and technical deep-dives – and manage technical stakeholder relationships from engineering and operations teams up to C-level. • Work cross-functionally with internal teams – Product Management, Engineering, Delivery / Professional Services, Commercial, and Bid Management – and with external parties – operators, system integrators, hyperscalers, and O-RAN / ecosystem partners – to assemble winning and deliverable solutions. • Generate thought-leadership content – white papers, blogs, reference architectures, and webinars – and representCompany at industry events and standards / community forums such as TM Forum and the O-RAN ALLIANCE. • Stay ahead of telecom market trends – Open RAN, 5G and 5G-Advanced, cloud-native CNFs and Kubernetes, observability and telemetry, GenAI and agentic AI for operations, and the shift toward data-driven, autonomous networks – and bring that insight into customer conversations and internal strategy. Requirements: • Must-have demonstrable skills & expertise:• Exceptional verbal and written communication, executive presentation, and storytelling skills, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear business value. • Proven hands-on pre-sales and solution-architecture experience in the OSS domain for mobile operators and/or telecommunication vendors, including ownership of RFx responses and customer-facing technical engagements. • Deep, demonstrable expertise across the Service Assurance domain – fault, performance, and service-quality management, customer-experience management, and AI/ML-driven assurance (anomaly detection, correlation, automated root-cause analysis, and predictive / proactive assurance). • Strong working knowledge of network automation and autonomy – closed-loop assurance and orchestration, intent-based operations, and the TM Forum Autonomous Networks framework (Levels 0–5). • Familiarity with O-RAN architecture and SMO / RIC platforms, including the Non-RT RIC (rApps, R1, A1), the Near-RT RIC (xApps, E2), and the O1 / O2 management interfaces. • Exposure to public clouds (GCP, Azure, and AWS) and to cloud service models (IaaS, PaaS, DBaaS), with an appreciation of hybrid / multi-cloud and O-Cloud deployment models. • Working knowledge of TM Forum standards and Open APIs / Open Digital Architecture (ODA), and of data and observability technologies (streaming pipelines, telemetry, and data lakes). • Demonstrated ability to lead and coordinate virtual, cross-functional bid and solution teams across multiple geographies and time zones, and to manage internal and external stakeholders. • Willingness to travel as required.
